exposure: Regular dose probiotic supplemented infant formula
Low dose probiotic supplemented infant formula
regular dose (10(7) CFU/g of powder) of the probiotic Bifidobacterium lactis CNCM I-3446
low dose (10(4) CFU/g of powder) of B. lactis
finding: Supplementing starter infant formula with a low dose of Bifidobacterium lactis CNCM I-3446 in infants born by C-section demonstrated similar effects on immune and gut maturation compared to regular dose supplementation or breastfeeding.
